summary: This 8-K reports routine operational items for BlackRock Private Credit Fund, a non-traded BDC. It discloses an unregistered sale of 245,505.01 Institutional Class shares to feeder vehicles for $5,778,304 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S and a regular quarterly distribution of $0.1775 per share across classes, payable September 28, 2026. It also provides NAV per share of $23.54 as of July 31, 2026. These are ordinary capital-raising and dividend events with no strategic transformation, so the filing does not constitute a special situation.
